section_overviews.commercial_observer:
Whole Foods to Open Daily Shop at Murray Hill’s 509 Third Avenue: Whole Foods Market has leased a 9,000-square-foot retail space in Manhattan’s Murray Hill neighborhood. The 15-year deal occupies a ground-floor space and outdoor terraces at 509 Third Avenue , according to a memorandum of lease filed in city records Friday morning.

Mac Cosmetics’ SoHo Flagship Relocates to 5K SF at 579 Broadway: Mac Cosmetics has selected a new foundation in Manhattan’s SoHo neighborhood. The global makeup brand signed a 5,325-square-foot lease at 579 Broadway between Prince and East Houston streets to host its next flagship location in the trendy shopping corridor, according to an announcement from landlord broker Newmark .

Westfield Montgomery Owner Pays Off $350M Loan on Bethesda, Md., Mall: Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield (URW) has paid off a $350 million loan tied to the Westfield Montgomery shopping mall in Bethesda, Md., more than two years after the debt was transferred to special servicing. The 1.2 million-square-foot mall’s loan had been scheduled to mature Aug.

Fashion Boutique Atelier Secures Retail Space at 181 MacDougal Street: Fashion boutique Atelier New York is upgrading its retail footprint in Manhattan’s Greenwich Village. The multi-brand luxury boutique will be the inaugural tenant in the commercial component of the Straus Group ’s newly constructed 181 MacDougal Street luxury condominium building, Commercial Observer has learned.
section_overviews.cre_daily:
July Retail Sales Dip as Online Spending Pulls Back: Marcus & Millichap Research Services reported core retail sales fell 0.2% in July but remained 4.8% above year-earlier levels. Online spending dropped 2.3%, its largest monthly decline since January 2025.

Nike Closes 15 Small Format Nike Live Retail Stores: Nike has permanently closed at least 15 Nike Live stores across 12 states, per Retail Dive. The concept launched in 2018 on Melrose Avenue with footprints planned at roughly 4K SF.

NYC Grocery Lawsuit Puts Subsidized Retail Space at Risk: The Multicultural Business Coalition, representing roughly 65 grocer organizations, sued New York City over Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s plan for city-owned, subsidized municipal grocery stores.

Spirit Halloween Turns Retail Vacancies into Seasonal Wins: Spirit Halloween opens roughly 1,500 temporary stores annually through a specialized leasing operation targeting vacant retail space. Flexible termination clauses let landlords collect temporary rent while preserving opportunities to sign permanent tenants.

items.headline: Whole Foods to Open Daily Shop at Murray Hill’s 509 Third Avenue
items.summary: Whole Foods Market has leased a 9,000-square-foot retail space in Manhattan’s Murray Hill neighborhood. The 15-year deal occupies a ground-floor space and outdoor terraces at 509 Third Avenue , according to a memorandum of lease filed in city records Friday morning. The 35-story, 229-unit apartment tower, known as the Murray , was developed by Kahen Properties with Lalezarian Properties . A spokesperson for Whole Foods confirmed the lease in an email to Commercial Observer, but declined to share further details.…

items.headline: Mac Cosmetics’ SoHo Flagship Relocates to 5K SF at 579 Broadway
items.summary: Mac Cosmetics has selected a new foundation in Manhattan’s SoHo neighborhood. The global makeup brand signed a 5,325-square-foot lease at 579 Broadway between Prince and East Houston streets to host its next flagship location in the trendy shopping corridor, according to an announcement from landlord broker Newmark . The deal represents a relocation of just two blocks from Mac’s current perch alongside Bloomingdale’s at 506 Broadway .…

items.headline: Westfield Montgomery Owner Pays Off $350M Loan on Bethesda, Md., Mall
items.summary: Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield (URW) has paid off a $350 million loan tied to the Westfield Montgomery shopping mall in Bethesda, Md., more than two years after the debt was transferred to special servicing. The 1.2 million-square-foot mall’s loan had been scheduled to mature Aug. 1, Bisnow reported. Morningstar Credit described the payoff as a “rarity in a cycle” in which many mall loans continue to receive extensions. URW secured the 10-year loan in 2014, with the debt tied to 836,000 square feet of the property.…

items.headline: Fashion Boutique Atelier Secures Retail Space at 181 MacDougal Street
items.summary: Fashion boutique Atelier New York is upgrading its retail footprint in Manhattan’s Greenwich Village. The multi-brand luxury boutique will be the inaugural tenant in the commercial component of the Straus Group ’s newly constructed 181 MacDougal Street luxury condominium building, Commercial Observer has learned. Asking rent for the 2,130-square-foot retail space was $250 per square foot, according to landlord broker Newmark .…

items.headline: July Retail Sales Dip as Online Spending Pulls Back
items.summary: Marcus & Millichap Research Services reported core retail sales fell 0.2% in July but remained 4.8% above year-earlier levels. Online spending dropped 2.3%, its largest monthly decline since January 2025. Seven of 10 retail categories still posted gains. Apparel sales rose 1.9%. Off-price retailers signed more than 100 leases totaling roughly 3M SF during the 12 months through July.…

items.headline: Nike Closes 15 Small Format Nike Live Retail Stores
items.summary: Nike has permanently closed at least 15 Nike Live stores across 12 states, per Retail Dive. The concept launched in 2018 on Melrose Avenue with footprints planned at roughly 4K SF. The closures land during a punishing year that included a 12-year stock low and a JPMorgan downgrade. Key Takeaways According to Bisnow, Nike is closing at least 15 stores it opened under the Nike Live banner. The format was built to serve shoppers in their own neighborhoods.…

items.headline: Dermatology Chain LaserAway Adds 15th NYC Location on the Upper East Side
items.summary: Skin care, hair removal and body wellness services provider LaserAway is getting ready to open its 15th New York City location on Manhattan’s Upper East Side, Commercial Observer has learned. LaserAway signed a 10-year lease for 1,800 square feet on the ground floor of a mixed-use property at 242 East 86th Street , according to a source close to the deal. Asking rent was $165 per square foot.…

items.headline: Seafood Restaurant Crab House Takes 7K SF at 11 East 13th Street
items.summary: It’s the catch of the day! All-you-can-eat seafood chain Crab House has secured its fourth New York City location at 11 East 13th Street in Manhattan’s Greenwich Village neighborhood, Commercial Observer has learned. The 6,500-square-foot space between Fifth Avenue and University Place went fishing for a new proprietor in early August, following the departure of Mediterranean tapas restaurant Reyna New York.…

items.headline: Pilates Studio Sancta Selects Tribeca’s 124 Hudson Street for First Location
items.summary: A high-end Pilates studio has found its center in Manhattan’s Tribeca neighborhood. Sancta , a studio specializing in reformer Pilates, has inked a 2,350-square-foot lease for its debut location at 124 Hudson Street , Commercial Observer has learned. The studio agreed to a seven-year term with landlord Marx Realty for the ground-floor lease, with an asking rent of $150 per square foot.…

items.headline: NYC Grocery Lawsuit Puts Subsidized Retail Space at Risk
items.summary: The Multicultural Business Coalition, representing roughly 65 grocer organizations, sued New York City over Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s plan for city-owned, subsidized municipal grocery stores. Under the proposal, the city would own five grocery locations while outside operators run them rent-free, a structure the coalition argues independent grocers cannot match.…

items.headline: Spirit Halloween Turns Retail Vacancies into Seasonal Wins
items.summary: Spirit Halloween opens roughly 1,500 temporary stores annually through a specialized leasing operation targeting vacant retail space. Flexible termination clauses let landlords collect temporary rent while preserving opportunities to sign permanent tenants. The strategy shows how pop-up retail can monetize downtime, especially when bankrupt chains leave usable big-box locations behind.…

items.headline: Retail Location Intelligence Sharpens Site Selection
items.summary: Retail location intelligence platforms can model revenue, cash-on-cash returns, and store cannibalization down to specific streets and sites. Bain’s Vantage combines global data sets and machine learning with demographic, competitive, and retailer-specific information. Industry executives say technology improves site selection, but local sales knowledge and street-level context remain essential.…

items.headline: Westfield Topanga Tests Pop-Ups to Revive Food Hall
items.summary: URW is bringing Chain to Topanga Social for a six-month residency beginning September 2, 2026. The food hall has lost most of its original 25-plus vendors since opening at Westfield Topanga in 2023. The test reflects a broader push to use rotating dining and entertainment concepts to generate repeat mall visits. Key Takeaways CoStar reports that Westfield Topanga is trying a new food hall strategy after Topanga Social lost most of its original vendors.…

items.headline: Indian Restaurant Samudhra Takes 10K SF at 312 West 43rd Street
items.summary: New Jersey-based Indian restaurant Samudhra is establishing a presence across the Hudson River in Hell’s Kitchen. The eatery signed a 10,000-square-foot lease on the ground level of the Ellery at 312 West 43rd Street , owned by Taconic Partners and National Real Estate Advisors , for its second location in the U.S. following its first restaurant in Franklin Park, N.J., according to the landlords.…

items.headline: Vestal Point Capital Takes 12K SF at Rockrose Development’s 11 East 26th Street
items.summary: Investment firm and hedge fund manager Vestal Point Capital is relocating its offices within New York City. The company has inked a long-term, 12,139-square-foot lease on the entire 12th floor of Rockrose Development ’s 11 East 26th Street across the street from Manhattan’s Madison Square Park , Commercial Observer has learned. The company’s current address is listed on its website as 632 Broadway in NoHo. It is unclear when the firm will move. The exact length of the lease was unclear.…

items.headline: Reforming Pilates to Open New Studio at 233 East 34th Street in Murray Hill
items.summary: Almost started this story with a workout pun, but that would have been too much of a stretch. Fitness brand Reforming Pilates , which offers reformer equipment classes and heated mat workouts, has signed a 10-year, 2,500-square-foot lease to open a new location at 233 East 34th Street , according to landlord broker Meridian Capital Group . “Murray Hill is the heartbeat of Manhattan,” Genevieve Ross , founder of Reforming Pilates, said in a statement.…

items.headline: NYC Human Resources Administration Extends 174K-SF Lease in Midtown
items.summary: The New York City Department of Citywide Administrative Services (DCAS) extended the lease for a government agency in Midtown South. The New York City Human Resources Administration (HRA) will get an extra 18 months at Vornado Realty Trust ’s 260 11th Avenue , where it occupies 174,186 square feet, according to a source close to the deal.…

items.headline: Cricket Training Facility Takes 14K SF Near Bryant Park for First U.S. Location
items.summary: Anyone fancy a game of cricket? Century Cricket Centre , an Australia-based indoor cricket and sports-tech concept, will open its first U.S. location in New York City, having inked a 14,000-square-foot lease at Thor Equities ’ 25 West 39th Street a block south of Bryant Park , tenant broker Lee & Associates NYC announced Tuesday.…

items.headline: Retail Location Intelligence Grows in Sophistication and Usage
items.summary: In the late 1960s, science fiction writer Arthur C. Clarke posited a now-famous law of the universe: “Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic.” As the rapid advancement of technology, especially given the ongoing progress of artificial intelligence, often makes this seem truer by the day, its implications in commercial real estate are often of a type that would have seemed like pure voodoo to CRE professionals when Clarke put forth this statement.…

items.headline: Pizza Napoli to Open in 3K SF at 383 Fifth Avenue
items.summary: As one pizzeria shuts down, another is growing in its place, Commercial Observer has learned. Pizza Napoli has signed a 2,500-square-foot lease at Jonathan and Jan Soleimani ’s 383 Fifth Avenue just off East 36th Street in Midtown, where asking rent started at $25,000 per month, according to landlord broker Meridian Capital Group . The tenant signed a 15-year lease for the space, Meridian said. The site was previously the home of Famous Italian Pizza.…

items.headline: How Do You Get to Albany? Take a Left.
items.summary: Albany could be ripe for revolution next year when a slew of socialists prepare to occupy the State Capitol for longer than a typical sit-in. Two months ago, as Mayor Zohran Mamdani-backed candidates Claire Valdez and Darializa Avila Chevalier triumphed in their congressional primaries, a dozen lesser-known candidates endorsed by the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) also won a clear path to seats in the New York State Legislature.…
